title: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1982-04-06
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) ->
source: (FOB) Nakamichi 700 (With Bass EQ) -> Cassette Master (Sony D5M/Maxell DXLIIS/Dolby B) D

ai_review.summary: A high‑energy 1982 Spectrum show captured on a matrix audience tape, featuring smoking Shakedown Street, an epic Other One / Morning Dew sequence and crisp, well‑balanced vocals.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its clear, well‑mixed audience sound with only minor glitches, delivering an engaging listening experience. The performance shines in the second set – a standout Shakedown Street interplay, a soaring Other One → Morning Dew transition and strong finishes on Sugar Magnolia and Baby Blue – while the first set is solid though occasionally deemed uneven. Overall the show is considered one of the better 1982 dates.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews are 4‑5 stars, highlighting both excellent musical moments and a high‑quality matrix recording; only a few mixed or low ratings appear, leading to a strong positive overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience‑derived matrix praised for crisp vocals, clear instrument separation and good balance; minor split‑second cuts/glitches noted but not detrimental.

poor_songs: Terrapin Station (in one review noted as flat)
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set solid but uneven; second set builds momentum with a long drums‑space, superb Shakedown Street trade and a powerful Other One/Dew/Blue climax.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Consistently praised for being "ON", delivering strong vocals and guitar work, especially on Shakedown Street and the emotive Morning Dew.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass highlighted as thundering and clearly audible, particularly during Morning Dew.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocals noted as powerful on Promised Land and throughout; sings with heart and intensity.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland's keyboard levels described as perfect; notable extended trading with Jerry on Shakedown Street.
band_member_comments.Drums: Long drums‑space segment praised; overall drumming considered solid and supportive of the jams.
